prompt: Who was the last Miss World America to place in the Top 11 at Miss World? Hint: She has pursued a modeling career.
answer: **Audra Mari** was the last Miss World America to place in the **Top 11 at Miss World**, finishing in the Top 11 at **Miss World 2016** and earning the title of **Miss World Americas**. She later pursued a modeling and television-hosting career.
